jobs.title: Technical Oversight - Underwriting
jobs.description: About Pylon America’s $13T mortgage market is one of the most important financial systems in the world. It underwrites the middle class and is the mechanism through which millions of families build wealth. But while every other financial instrument has been simplified to an API call, mortgages are still assembled by hand. We started from zero and created the first vertically integrated mortgage platform that turns origination into a single API. Publicly traded companies and the country’s largest originators are already building on Pylon. Revenue is compounding monthly. We’re backed by Peter Thiel, Conversion Capital, QED, Citi, Fifth Wall, and the founders of Ramp, Blend, and Mercury. Working at Pylon isn’t for those seeking comfort. The people who thrive here have high agency, strong opinions, and a track record of delivering outcomes without direction. Many of us are former founders. We move quickly, challenge each other directly, and take full ownership of results. It’s hard work, but it will be worth it. Join us in building America’s mortgage rails . About The Role We’re seeking an entrepreneurial Technical Oversight - Underwriting. This role involves both strategic oversight and hands-on management of third party fulfillment providers to ensure efficient, compliant loan origination while enhancing systems and workflows for high-quality, scalable operations. You will be instrumental in shaping the future of our platform, developing underwriting workflows, standard operating procedures, and quality control measures. You will provide tactical guidance to engineering teams, emphasizing scalable human out of the loop solutions. We are not a traditional mortgage lender. If you’re excited about building flexible automated systems with rigorous oversight that can scale, this role is for you. jobs.description: Product Manager, Lead to Cash Location: London, onsite 5 days a week Retire The ERP. Light exists to replace factory-era ERPs with software that feels alive. Our Smart Financial Platform gives modern, global companies superpowers: automated accounting, real-time reporting, and financial flows that move at the speed of the business. We build with our customers, ship fast, and obsess over craft. In a short time, Light has gone from idea to the operating core for leading companies like Lovable, Legora, and Keyshot. We’re an early team defining a new software category. If you’re excited to modernise how the world runs money, one agentic workflow at a time, you’re in the right place. Backed by world-class investors and advised by industry titans, we’re building category-defining products with the freedom to ship ambitiously and own outcomes. Come help us make Light the global default for next-gen finance. About The Role This is a hands-on product role reporting to the VP of Product Development. You’ll own Lead to Cash: everything between a signed deal and cash in the bank. That covers contracts, billing and invoicing, revenue recognition, payments, and credit control. You’ll set the roadmap for the area with the VP, and your discovery and judgement decide what actually ships. In Lead to Cash, the ledger has to keep up with whatever commercial terms each customer signs. A contract changes mid-term, and the invoices, deferred revenue and reporting all have to follow. A parent company wants one bill for a dozen subsidiaries. A customer’s Stripe setup doesn’t match how they actually sell. Every customer bills a little differently, and the product has to absorb those differences without turning into a pile of one-offs. You work out which problems are patterns worth building for and which aren’t, and you say so. jobs.title: Global Payroll Lead
jobs.description: About the job: Hi, I’m Atlee and I’m the Controller at Ashby . We're hiring a Global Payroll Lead to own payroll for our fast-growing, global employee base. We pay employees across an ever-growing number of U.S. states and internationally, through a mix of local entities and employers of record (EOR). Every pay cycle has more people, more jurisdictions and more complexity than the one before. This is a senior individual contributor role. You’ll be the company’s payroll expert and the person accountable for getting it right. You’ll run the day-to-day work yourself and also design how payroll should run as we scale. We’re looking for someone who stands out in customer service, analytical horsepower, attention to detail, independent time management and speed. Payroll is a critical part of both the employee experience and business operations. You’ll own the full payroll cycle (semi-monthly and monthly) across all of our populations. That covers the details behind it: employee data changes, leave events, bonuses, commissions, deductions, off-cycle payments and final pay. It also covers the controls, vendors and processes that hold it all together. You’ll partner closely with Finance, People Operations, Benefits, Legal, managers, employees and external providers so that payroll is right the first time, and when it isn’t, issues get resolved quickly and the root cause gets fixed. What you’ll do Own recurring payroll activities across U.S., U.K., Canadian, and international EOR/contractor populations, coordinating timelines, inputs, approvals, processing, and final review. Collect, validate, and enter payroll changes, including new hires, terminations, compensation changes, promotions, bonuses, commissions, deductions, reimbursements, leave, and return-to-work events. Review payroll registers and supporting reports for accuracy, reconcile discrepancies, and coordinate corrections, off-cycle payments, and retroactive adjustments. So far, we’ve contributed over $18 million AUD (roughly $12.5 million USD) to fund sanitation projects around the globe. Basically, we’re really good at doing good. With hubs in Australia, the Philippines, China, the US, UK and Europe, our amazing team of 200+ work to make the biggest possible impact for people and the planet. Over the next couple of years, we’re hoping to increase our annual donation tenfold to get us closer to our dream of everyone in the world having access to clean water and sanitation services. It’s a finance-side role — think careful admin and attention to detail in Excel or Google Sheets, not managing a payroll system. Unsere Mission ist es, Gemeinschaften beim Übergang von der Krise zur Erholung, Rehabilitation und nachhaltigen Lebensführung zu unterstützen. In unseren Projekten im In- und Ausland verbinden wir psychosozial Unterstützung, Empowermentarbeit und humanitäre Hilfsgüterlieferungen. jobs.description: PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk (BSI) adalah bank di Indonesia yang bergerak di bidang perbankan syariah. BSI merupakan bank hasil merger antara PT Bank BRI syariah Tbk, PT Bank Syariah Mandiri dan PT Bank BNI Syariah. Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK) secara resmi mengeluarkan izin merger tiga usaha bank syariah tersebut pada 27 Januari 2021 melalui surat Nomor SR-3/PB.1/2021. Berikut ini adalah Lowongan Kerja PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk. Komposisi pemegang saham BSI adalah: PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk 50,83%, PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) Tbk 24,85%, PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk 17,25%. Sisanya adalah pemegang saham yang masing-masing di bawah 5%. Penggabungan ini menyatukan kelebihan dari ketiga bank syariah tersebut, sehingga menghadirkan layanan yang lebih lengkap, jangkauan lebih luas, serta memiliki kapasitas permodalan yang lebih baik. Didukung sinergi dengan perusahaan serta komitmen pemerintah melalui Kementerian BUMN, BSI didorong untuk dapat bersaing di tingkat global. Lowongan Kerja PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk Saat ini PT Bank Syariah Indonesia (BSI) membuka kesempatan untuk dapat bergabung bersama dengan posisi sebagai berikut: Private Banking Relationship Manager Key Responsibilities: Build and manage long-term relationships with High Net Worth Individuals (HNWIs) and affluent clients Provide tailored wealth management, investment, and financial planning solutions aligned with clients financial goals Grow Assets Under Management (AUM) through portfolio development, client acquisition, and relationship expansion Deliver holistic advisory services across investment, protection, and wealth preservation solutions Identify new business opportunities through networking, referrals, and market engagement Maintain the highest standards of client service, professionalism, confidentiality, and regulatory compliance Requirements: Bachelor s Degree (S1) from any discipline. Minimum 5 years of experience in Banking, Wealth Management, Priority Banking
